name: Peace With God
overview: Scripture reveals that true peace with God is a gift granted through faith in Jesus Christ, as believers are justified and reconciled to God (Romans 5:1). This peace transcends worldly circumstances, offering strength and perfect tranquility to those who trust in the Lord and fix their minds on Him (Psalms 29:11; Isaiah 26:3). Jesus Himself assures believers of a peace unlike that of the world, encouraging them to be courageous despite tribulation because He has overcome the world (John 14:27; John 16:33). Furthermore, living according to the Spirit, rather than the flesh, brings life and peace, underscoring the spiritual nature of this divine peace (Romans 8:6).
